role: Single helper computing an MKCoordinateRegion bounding route coordinates with padding/minimum span.

units.does: Returns a region centred on the lat/lon midpoint with span (max-min)*paddingFactor floored at minimumDelta and capped at 180°/360°. Longitudes go through unwrappedLongitudes, so a route across the ±180° meridian is bounded across it and its centre is normalised back into ±180°. Empty input returns a 0,0-centred region with emptyFallbackDelta span.

flags.text: Doc calls this "the one shared implementation for the app's route maps", yet three other units recompute the same min/max bounding region with their own padding: TrailRow.mapRegion, RecapCard.snapshotOptions, WorkoutPDFRenderer.mapSnapshotOptions.

units.does: Returns the longitudes unchanged unless their raw extent exceeds 180°, in which case negative ones are shifted by +360° so the extent is the route's real width across the antimeridian.
